author: IzaakWN
body:
## PR description:

Some python3 minor fixes in `runTheMatrix.py`:
- Convert `dict.keys()` and `map()` explicitly to list to make `--apply`, `--keep`, completion in `--interactive` work as expected.
- Convert `str.format()` to f-strings for consistency.

## PR validation:

- CMSSW & python compile.
- Checked
  ```bash
  runTheMatrix.py --help
    ...
    -l TESTLIST, --list TESTLIST
                          Comma separated list of workflow to be shown or ran. Possible keys are also run1_run2, run3, phase2, heavyIons,
                          jetmc, metmc, muonmc, ph2_hlt, limited. and wild card like muon, or mc (default: None)
    ...
  ```
- Checked that completion in `--interactive` works for empty text when hitting tab:
  ```bash
  matrix> showWorkflow 
  2017            data_highstats  generator       identity        pileup          standard        
  Run4            extendedgen     gpu             machine         premix          upgrade         
  cleanedupgrade  ged             highstats       nano            production
  matrix> runWorkflow 
  2017            data_highstats  generator       identity        pileup          standard        
  Run4            extendedgen     gpu             machine         premix          upgrade         
  cleanedupgrade  ged             highstats       nano            production 
  matrix> searchInWorkflow 
  2017            data_highstats  generator       identity        pileup          standard        
  Run4            extendedgen     gpu             machine         premix          upgrade         
  cleanedupgrade  ged             highstats       nano            production
  ```
- Checked `--apply` now works as expected:
  ```bash
  runTheMatrix.py -l 34522.0 --what upgrade --nEvents 2 --maxSteps 3 --nThreads 2 --command "--customise_commands 'process.RandomNumberGeneratorService.generator.initialSeed=2\nprocess.generator.firstRun = 2'" --apply 0
  ...
  cmsDriver.py TenTau_E_15_500_Eta3p1_pythia8_cfi  -s GEN,SIM -n 2 --conditions auto:phase2_realistic_T35_13TeV --beamspot DBrealisticHLLHC --datatier GEN-SIM --eventcontent FEVTDEBUG --geometry ExtendedRun4D121 --era Phase2C22I13M9 --relval 9000,100 --customise_commands 'process.RandomNumberGeneratorService.generator.initialSeed=2\nprocess.generator.firstRun = 2' --fileout file:step1.root  --nThreads 2 > step1_TenTau_15_500_Eta3p1+Run4D121.log  2>&1
  ...
  ```
title: Minor python3 fixes in runTheMatrix.py
